name: clash
description: Operate the complete local Clash creative workspace through Codex tools and focused GUI Apps.

interface.shortDescription: Run your local Clash workspace from Codex
interface.longDescription: Run Clash as a third local client directly inside Codex. The plugin reuses an active Desktop/local-api host when available, or starts its own bundled local-api runtime on first use. Work with projects, Canvas, Timeline, Director, assets, models, tasks, text, and production through focused MCP App interfaces.
defaultPrompt: Open Clash Studio and show my local projects.
